'''Tholme's commandeered fighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] stationed aboard the [[Raptor (starship)|''Raptor'']]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] stole it to escape the doomed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] as it was exploding.
